select a.SEQ_NO, a.WORKFLOW_ID from sys_wfl_business_list a, sys_data_process_mark b where 1=1 AND a.PROCESS_STATE = #{state} AND a.seq_no = b.workflow_id and b.BUSINESS_DATA_PK1 = #{tradeId}
mapper.insert: insert into PTL_TRADE ( PORTFOLIO_ID, BUSI_NO, BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID, BUSI_NO || 'R' , BUSI_TABLE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_TYPE, INV_AIM, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, SETTLE_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser}, sysdate FROM PTL_TRADE WHERE BUSI_NO = #{tradeId}
mapper.select: SELECT tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpda.RED_CFM_DATE, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SETTLE_DATE, tpd.PS, tpd.CHL_ID, tpd.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_PLAT, tpd.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, tpd.FEE_AMT_PAY, tpd.INV_AIM, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.CCY, tpd.TRADE_AMT, tpd.PRIN_AMT, tpd.SHARE_AMT, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.UNIT_INT, tpd.UNIT_FPRICE, tpd.CPRICE_DATE, tpd.CPRICE_AMT, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.INT_AMT, tpd.FPRICE_AMT, tpd.YIELD, tpd.EXER_YIELD, tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, FD.FEE_AMT CHANNEL_AMT, fp.finprod_market_id finprodMarketId FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd ON ptpd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL FD ON FD.TRADE_ID=TPD.B_TRADE_ID AND FD.FEE_TYPE='B09' AND FD.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE='Y' WHERE tpd.B_TRADE_ID = #{tradId} and tpd.PS = #{psT24}

select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId, tpda.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, nvl(pt.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) portfolioId, DET_PS_FEE.FEE_AMT feeAmtPay, case when tpd.PS=#{PS_T01} then tpd.PRIN_AMT when tpd.PS=#{PS_T02} then tpd.PRIN_AMT else tpd.TRADE_AMT end as tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, tpd.PRIN_AMT prinAmt,
DET_C.FEE_AMT commissionAmt, det.fee_amt channelFee
,tpd.PRIN_AMT tradeAmtHid ,tpd.PRIN_AMT tradeAmtHid2 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID
left join ptl_trade pt on pt.BUSI_NO = tpd.TRADE_ID and pt.PORTFOLIO_ID != tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL DET_PS_FEE ON DET_PS_FEE.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and DET_PS_FEE.FEE_TYPE IN (#{FEE_TYPE_B18}, #{FEE_TYPE_B15}, #{FEE_TYPE_B14}) LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL DET_C ON DET_C.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and DET_C.FEE_TYPE=#{FEE_TYPE_C} left join Trd_Trade_Fee_Detail det ON det.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and det.fee_type='B09' LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID where tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} /*and PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'*/ AND tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS='01' and not exists (select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A where 1=1 and A.B_TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and A.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' and A.TRADE_STATUS='01') and not exists ( select 1 from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B where B.B_TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID) order by tpd.create_time
SELECT UNIT_CPRICE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where trade_id = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT UNIT_CPRICE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1
